description: EXAMPLE curriculum for `train --curriculum <file>` (card 20261115_081635): 4 ordered stages over ONE SloughGPTTrainer — only the data swaps between stages, model/optimizer/global_step/EWC state carry across boundaries. Corpora are this repo's own docs so the example runs from a fresh checkout; point datasets[].path at your own text (an explicit file path, or a data/<name>/input.txt dataset name; .jsonl files contribute each record's text field). GATE THRESHOLDS (max_eval_loss 4.0, min_quality 0.3, max_toxicity 0.2) ARE PLACEHOLDERS — calibrate them on a real run before relying on verdicts. On gate failure the default policy logs a warning, marks the checkpoint PROVISIONAL, and advances; set a stage's on_gate_fail to abort to stop the run instead. eval_text is held out from every stage.
